question_text:
Passage: 'COA Audit Observation Memorandum No. 2024-05, dated March 15, 2024, notes that the Municipality of San Juan failed to remit P2.5 million in withholding taxes for the third quarter of 2023. The memorandum also cites the lack of a complete inventory of government property as a recurring issue. It recommends that the Local Government Unit (LGU) strictly comply with tax remittance deadlines and conduct a full physical inventory within 60 days.'

According to the passage, what amount of withholding taxes was not remitted?

options.text: P2.5 million for the third quarter of 2023
P2.5 million for the fourth quarter of 2023
P2.5 million for the third quarter of 2024
P2.5 million for the entire year of 2023
